SELECT ufp.user_id, ufp.user_financial_profile_id, ufp.annual_income, ufp.income_type, ufp.employment_status, ufp.credit_score,
COALESCE( ufp.liquid_asset_amount, 0 ) AS liquid_asset_amount,
COALESCE( ta.total_income, 0 ) AS total_income,
COALESCE( ta.total_expense, 0 ) AS total_expense,
COALESCE( ta.savings_amount, 0 ) AS savings_amount,
COALESCE( ta.savings_rate, 0 ) AS savings_rate,
COALESCE( ta.spending_cv, 0 ) AS spending_cv,
COALESCE( la.actual_dsr, 0 ) AS actual_dsr,
COALESCE( la.stress_dsr, 0 ) AS stress_dsr
FROM user_financial_profile ufp
LEFT JOIN transaction_analysis ta ON ta.transaction_analysis_id = (
SELECT ta2.transaction_analysis_id
FROM transaction_analysis ta2
WHERE ta2.user_financial_profile_id = ufp.user_financial_profile_id
ORDER BY ta2.analysis_year_month DESC, ta2.generated_at DESC
LIMIT 1 )
LEFT JOIN loan_analysis la ON la.loan_analysis_id = (
SELECT la2.loan_analysis_id
FROM loan_analysis la2
WHERE la2.user_financial_profile_id = ufp.user_financial_profile_id
ORDER BY la2.analysis_base_date DESC, la2.created_at DESC
LIMIT 1 )
WHERE ufp.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY ufp.updated_at DESC, ufp.user_financial_profile_id DESC
LIMIT 1
